rule.summary: Derive flag = (movsxd(esi) != 0) via a bit trick, then call 0x5656fc0 with (obj+0x60, obj+0x60, flag, 0x918940) and tail-jump to 0x5656fc0 with (obj+0x90, obj+0x90, flag, 0x918940).
rule.flag: rbx = 1 ^ (((~n) & (n-1)) >> 63) where n = movsxd(esi); equivalently flag = 1 if n != 0 else 0.
rule.flag_proof: Bit 63 of ~n is 1 iff n >= 0; bit 63 of n-1 is 1 iff n <= 0 (n is 32-bit sign-extended, so no overflow edge); their AND has bit 63 set iff n == 0. Shr 63 therefore yields 1 iff n == 0, and xor 1 flips it to the nonzero flag.
